title: Otter Power-Ups: Discover Workflows for Effective Study Notes
blurb: Student-facing workshop to go beyond the basics of using Otter.ai for note-taking.

featured_slides.note: Otter provides structured notes automatically, but structure alone is insufficient for durable learning. This slide frames the three evidence-based principles — active recall, spaced retrieval, and conceptual depth — that the rest of the session's workflows are designed to layer on top of what Otter already produces.

Flashcard-based workflows are among the most researched study strategies, but their effectiveness depends on how cards are constructed and sequenced. This slide walks through a hierarchical approach that moves students from recognition toward genuine recall, directly applying the principles introduced earlier in the session.

The resources build on the information shared in the workshop. Barbara Oakley's offers an engaging and personal perspective for why the recommended strategies work, while ANKI offers students who are comfortable with digital leanring the opportunity to apply their flashcard strategies while relying on automated spaced repetition to sustain the practice independently.
